scaling_light.scope: Full-cohort final-at-budget validation. Seeds 7/17/27; seed 7 exploratory, 17/27 prospective. Same validation rows, cohort-specific scalers and loss weights. IID is a diagnostic control, not the non-IID target.

scaling_iid.scope: Full-cohort final-at-budget validation. Seeds 7/17/27; seed 7 exploratory, 17/27 prospective. Same validation rows, cohort-specific scalers and loss weights. IID is a diagnostic control, not the non-IID target.

controls_light.scope: Exploratory 500k seed-7 controls only. Fixed final budgets; a cap changes exposure, aggregation and optimizer-reset frequency together. No seed variability estimate.

controls_iid.scope: Exploratory 500k seed-7 controls only. Fixed final budgets; a cap changes exposure, aggregation and optimizer-reset frequency together. No seed variability estimate.

controls_dirichlet.scope: Exploratory 500k seed-7 controls only. Fixed final budgets; a cap changes exposure, aggregation and optimizer-reset frequency together. No seed variability estimate.

controlled_noniid.scope: One anchored simulated partition and seed 7. Original 500k row ownership retained; cohort scaler, loss weights and local epoch length still differ. Not multi-seed confirmation.

aggregation.scope: One extra CPU diagnostic round from the frozen global checkpoint. Both aggregations use the same 20 client models; an ensemble requires 20 evaluations per flow, not one edge model.

panel.scope: Fixed 10152-row balanced panel, 1269 per class. Neural models: 300 epochs, 3045600 examples, 6000 updates; width changes parameter count/FLOPs. Fixed tree: one seed, unmatched work/capacity. Natural validation, not a full-cohort fair-compute comparison.

alert_primary.scope: Predeclared primary small-dropout control only; all other architecture operating points remain in alert-budget-results.json. Thresholds chosen and assessed on the SAME validation population; caps hold by construction, not independent guarantees.

prior.scope: Six frozen small-dropout models, panel control versus majority diversity at equal class exposure and work. One training-count prior correction, no retraining. Raw panel observations duplicate the panel control, not independent replications. No operational prior or calibration claim.
